episodes.title: Dinner at Seven-Thirty
episodes.plot: After drinking Ed's healing mixture, Joel dreams an alternate Manhattan where Cicely's residents occupy transformed roles and his own Alaska life looks unexpectedly valuable.

episodes.title: Eye of the Beholder
episodes.plot: Detective-in-training Ed investigates an insurance scam, Shelly becomes absorbed by an antique dollhouse, and Maggie and Maurice regret competitive acts of charity.

episodes.title: Shofar, So Good
episodes.plot: Yom Kippur brings Joel a ghostly rabbi who forces him to confront past and present failings, while Maurice hosts a distinguished guest for a fox hunt.

episodes.title: The Letter
episodes.plot: Joel worries over a strange lump, Shelly fears a broken chain letter, a barber settles in Cicely, and Maggie rereads a message written by her teenage self.

episodes.title: The Robe
episodes.plot: Shelly believes she has bargained with the devil, Ed bungles Joel's cold-medication trial, and Chris introduces a new on-air partner.

episodes.title: Zarya
episodes.plot: Marilyn's family story becomes Ed's cinematic vision of an early Alaska encounter involving Russian princess Anastasia, Lenin and a secret journey through Cicely's imagined past.

episodes.title: Full Upright Position
episodes.plot: Chris turns electricity into art, Joel and Maggie are trapped together on a Russian-bound flight, and Maurice tries to groom a visiting cousin as his successor.

episodes.title: Up River
episodes.plot: A gun dispute with Maggie pushes Joel into a remote Native village, while construction wrecks Chris's familiar home and Ruth-Anne gives in to romance.

episodes.title: Sons of the Tundra
episodes.plot: New doctor Phil Capra and journalist wife Michelle arrive in Cicely, Ed experiences visions of the future, and Holling pursues membership in a traditional men's club.

episodes.title: Realpolitik
episodes.plot: New mayor Maggie discovers that winning office is easier than governing, while Chris reacts strangely to her authority, Marilyn tries dog breeding and Joel invites Phil golfing.

episodes.title: The Great Mushroom
episodes.plot: Maggie visits Joel in Manonash fearing she drove him away, while Phil and Michelle's dinner guests become unexpectedly demanding and Ed contemplates the emerging digital world.

episodes.title: Mi Casa, Su Casa
episodes.plot: Marilyn's visit unsettles Joel's hard-won calm, Ed exploits Maurice's generosity while house-sitting, and Holling discovers that home ownership feels more like confinement than security.

episodes.title: Horns
episodes.plot: Maurice's bottled Cicely water causes bizarre reversals in sexual behavior, fugitive violinist Cal resurfaces, and Joel learns his Alaska contract is finally over.

episodes.title: The Mommy's Curse
episodes.plot: A death connected to Maggie's mother revives fears of an O'Connell curse, while Walt and Ruth-Anne test domestic compatibility and Maurice envies Holling's friendship with Phil.

episodes.title: The Quest
episodes.plot: Joel takes Maggie searching for the mythical Jeweled City of the North, a journey that brings his Cicely story to a decisive end as other residents face legal and culinary disputes.

episodes.title: Lucky People
episodes.plot: Phil and Michelle regret their new property, Chris and Maggie restore Cicely's old Model T, and Maurice becomes convinced Shelly's baby carries the spirit of his uncle.

episodes.title: The Graduate
episodes.plot: Chris defends his graduate work before clashing professors, Maggie buys the neglected movie theater, and a young visitor arrives believing Holling may be his father.

episodes.title: Little Italy
episodes.plot: Phil stumbles into a feud among Cicely's Italian families, Maggie is drafted into marriage counseling for Holling and Shelly, and Ruth-Anne discovers the burden of sudden public attention.

episodes.title: Balls
episodes.plot: Cicely's bowling championship coincides with a serious rift between Phil and Michelle, while Ed pursues Heather and Chris finds himself increasingly drawn to Maggie.

episodes.title: Buss Stop
episodes.plot: Michelle stages a community production of Bus Stop, and the acting bug rapidly turns Cicely's residents into a collection of rivalries, egos and creative disputes.

episodes.title: Ursa Minor
episodes.plot: Ed adopts a bear cub and discovers the hazards of improvised parenthood, while Chris's dream experiments entangle him with an assertive hotel manager.

episodes.title: Let's Dance
episodes.plot: Cal seeks Maurice and Barbara's help surrendering to authorities, Phil offends Cicely's residents, and Chris is paired with a judgmental child in cotillion class.

episodes.title: Tranquility Base
episodes.plot: Friends gather at Maurice's summer lodge for a final stretch of rest, conversation and reflection as Cicely quietly closes one chapter of its communal life.
